description: A modular, stack-agnostic toolkit for AI coding agents to autonomously find, reproduce, and patch vulnerabilities.

written.description: Reads a codebase and its commit history, builds a threat model from them, and sends agents to chase each hypothesis it raises. It then tries to reproduce each finding in a sandbox and attacks its own patch to check the fix holds, working from source alone with no running target.

alive.last_commit_message:
Fix depth coverage rotation, effort precedence, repo-docs gating, and resume fidelity (#24)

Addresses depth planning, coverage rotation, reasoning-effort precedence,
repo-docs batch gating, judge neutrality, docs accuracy, and live-run bugs:

- Stop repeat default depth runs from flipping into file-by-file sweeps by
  gating _partial_uncovered_sweep on an active file-sweep ledger
  (has_active_file_sweep) and removing the implicit vs explicit --depth split.
- Rotate depth-calibrated batches onto uncovered/changed active files across
  repeat runs while keeping batch sizing anchored to total_active_files
  (preventing Zeno-shrinkage) and tracking depth in campaign_spend metadata.
- Prevent --depth 1..10 on >1,000-file repos from collapsing to whole-repo
  mode; honor depth min_depth in --scan-mode uncovered when --depth is explicit
  and warn when covered files came from a lower depth.
- Smooth whole_file_limit across depths 21..70 (eliminating the 29/30 cliff)
  and exclude doc/lock/CSS noise from legacy auto file-by-file sweeps.
- Restore reasoning_effort precedence (CLI > REASONING_EFFORT >
  workflow.local.json > depth > per-node), apply depth effort uniformly to
  prefix_group stems and extra --parallel workers, and reload depth effort plus
  explicit --passes 1 on --resume.
- Fix multi-file depth-batch repo-docs injection (_is_single_file_campaign) and
  inject INHERITED_STEM_NEUTRALITY_RULE into forked judge stages while keeping
  STAGE_PROMPTS under MAX_NODE_SYSTEM_PROMPT_CHARS / 2.
- Fix pause-banner boolean flag formatting (--no-memory instead of --no-memory
  True) and preserve peak per-file risk scores in record_calibration.
- Update READMEs, launch.py help/dry-run output, and mantis-launch skill docs.
